name: nlp_translation_eval
title: Evaluation-only translation scoring: beam-search decoding under @torch.no_grad() on an eval-mode model, then sacreBLEU and chrF over a saved prediction file
origin: hardening round 2, domain-nlp, 2026-09-14 - an evaluation-only program with generation, which is the shape a reviewer most often opens and the one with no training loop at all
note: Zero findings in both dataflow modes on 2026-09-14. This program exists to pin the negative: a workspace with no optimizer, no backward and no loss must not acquire a training-loop finding, and a generation loop that is already decorated must not acquire MLV301 / MLV302. It also records that `evaluate.load("sacrebleu")` has no knowledge table - an unresolved_callee diagnostic says so, which is the honest behaviour - so the two metric calls draw no metric node.

load() guards the device on torch.cuda.is_available() (line 12)
transformers.set_seed(SEED) is the first statement of main() (line 40)
